name: bulanci
description: Bulánci (2006) rebuilt in TypeScript: web, iOS and Android

scripts.assets: test -f bulanci.exe || (curl -fsSL -o bulanci_hra.zip https://www.bulanci.cz/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/bulanci_hra.zip && unzip -o -q bulanci_hra.zip bulanci.exe && rm bulanci_hra.zip) && python3 tools/extract.py bulanci.exe public/data
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
